items.title: Paramount settles US states’ lawsuit to unlock $110bn Warner deal
items.summary: Paramount is poised to close its $111bn (£83bn) takeover of Warner Bros after settling a legal challenge to block the deal.

items.title: Paramount settles with US states to clear Warner Bros. mega-merger
items.summary: Paramount has reached a settlement with a group of US states that clears the way for its takeover of Warner Bros.Paramount, which is run by David Ellison, whose ultra-wealthy family has ties to US President Donald Trump, won a bidding war in February for control of a stable of assets, including Warner Bros.

items.title: Is It Too Late To Buy Microsoft Stock After Its Summer Run?
items.summary: Microsoft (MSFT) stock is up about 30% in three months, including a 19% jump in the two trading days after its July report. That makes buying now feel late. Yet the stock is slightly lower than a year ago, while the S&P 500 (SPY) gained about 17%. With the stock trading near $500 a share, Wall Street consensus is already banking on Microsoft beating its own forecast again.

items.title: Can CoreWeave Stock Handle The Cost Of Its Own Growth?
items.summary: CoreWeave (CRWV) sells AI computing on NVIDIA GPUs through its own cloud, and demand for its capacity outruns supply. Revenue reached $2.6 billion in the second quarter of 2026, up 112% from a year earlier. The risk is in how that growth gets paid for.

items.title: Oracle’s Co-CEOs Deliver Explosive Growth, but Stock Plunges 50% in Their First Year
items.summary: Oracle's co-CEOs oversaw one of the fastest contract buildouts in enterprise software history, yet the stock cratered anyway. The question investors are wrestling with now cuts to the heart of the AI buildout era.
